meta.title: Math board
meta.description: Express quantity ideas with kid-friendly patterns and named groups; students set their own level colours and attach the board file.

title: Math board
teacherReferenceHint: Read-only reference, not your work. Never included in your answer. Use labels and stated conditions, not visual measurements.
workspaceSubtitle: Place shapes · group them · name the amounts
tapToAdd: Tap to place, or drag one in
settingsIntro: You choose which patterns sit in the toolbox, what each stands for, and which colour marks which amount.
patternsHint: Tap a pattern to put it on the left rail; tap again to tuck it away. Shapes already on the canvas stay.
settingsFutureDone: Saved. New shapes use the new value.
settingsExistingDone: Saved. Existing unmerged shapes also use the new value.
canvasEmpty: Pick a shape on the left to begin
canvasEmptyHint: Drag to arrange · box-select · Shift-click to add
gestureHint: Drag to arrange · box-select · Shift-click to add
groupedNoAlias: Shapes in a group share its name instead of having their own.
noSelection: Select one shape or box-select several to name, group, or merge them.
mergeReason: Merging needs the same shape, the same value, the same name, the same group, and a total that matches one of your levels.
hintGrouped: A whole group is selected: renaming changes the group.
hintSelected: Name, group or merge the selection.
hintEmpty: Drag shapes to arrange; drag on empty space to select several.
inspectorHint: Select shapes to name them here
noteHint: What do these shapes mean? How did you think about it?
noteGeneral: Whole board · not tied to particular shapes
appendHint: Tap shapes to add or remove them; useful on touch screens
practiceFileSaved: Practice file saved. The real draft was not changed.
practiceFileDownloaded: Practice download started. The disk write was not verified.
practiceFileLoaded: Practice board loaded. The real draft was not.
fileOpenFallback: Using the standard file picker; the browser may not remember the last location.
clearQuestion: Clear the canvas and this modification record? Files already added to an answer stay. This cannot be undone.
autoClearDone: Canvas and modifications cleared for the new task. Existing answer attachments remain.
autoClearSkipped: A late clear was skipped to keep later edits. Clear manually before using the board.
autoClearError: Automatic clear did not complete. Clear manually before using the board.
inserted: The board file is attached. Review it and send it yourself.
insertedNote: The board file is attached, and your own words are in the composer. Review them and send yourself.
insertFailed: Cannot insert now. Wait until the composer is editable and try again.
localDraft: Your draft stays here until you send it.
fileTooLarge: Choose a board JSON smaller than 256 KB.
storageError: Cannot save this browser draft. Save JSON to keep your work.
loadError: Cannot read the draft. Original data was not overwritten.
configApplied: Your spoken values and colours are now applied.
configGap: Settings history had a gap; retained changes were replayed with their original scopes.
configError: A settings update could not be applied; earlier successful changes were kept.
traceNotice: Changes stay in this browser, without times or drag paths. Your teacher sees them only if attached and sent; sent files remain with the conversation.
traceScope: Retained modifications to this draft so far, not necessarily one continuous sitting. These are observations, not correctness judgments; omitted details are marked.
tracePriorUnknown: Earlier process unknown: the starting board may have content, or history has a gap.
traceTotals: {count} changes recorded; {omitted} changes omitted in the middle.
traceResetQuestion: Keep the board and delete its local modification record to start anew? Existing draft/sent attachments remain. Undo history will also be cleared.
traceResetDone: New attempt started; board kept, earlier process marked unknown.
traceLoadError: Earlier modifications could not be restored and are marked unknown. The board remains usable.
traceRecordError: This change could not be added to the modification record; later process is marked unknown. The board itself is saved.
traceSkipped: Modification record unavailable. The board file is attached; review and send yourself.
demoCopyFull: The geometry canvas is too full. Make room, then try again.
geometryEmpty: Pick a tool, then click on the canvas to start drawing
geometryEmptyHint: Point · segment · triangle · circle · parallelogram · rectangle · polygon
geometryClearDone: Geometry canvas and undo history cleared.
geometryLoadError: Cannot read the geometry draft. Original data was not overwritten.
otherBoardFile: That is the other board's file; the geometry board cannot open it.
geometryClearQuestion: Clear the geometry canvas and its undo history? Files already added to an answer stay. This cannot be undone.
geometryImportFailed: That file could not be opened; the geometry canvas is unchanged.
practiceMoreChapters: Other operation chapters are still to come; basics is not the whole tutorial. Optional file practice does not block basics.
practiceSkippedEnd: This chapter includes skipped steps, not completed operations. Use the chapter list to practise them, or retry this chapter. Nothing was attached or sent.
practiceStorageWarning: Practice progress could not be read or saved reliably. You can continue or exit, but resuming after closing is not guaranteed. Retry this chapter to restart safely. Your real answer is separate.
practiceTargetMissing: A target object is missing. Reset this step or retry this chapter; your real answer is safe.
practiceTitle: Quantity safe practice — separate from your answer
practiceInsertBlocked: Nothing attached. First complete the operation shown above.
practiceFilesUnavailable: File practice is a later optional chapter. No real file was opened or saved.
practiceGoal_add:
Do: click a pattern in the rail on the left, or drag one onto the canvas.
Check: a new shape really appears; a drag you never drop does not count.
practiceGoal_move:
Do: drag the shape marked 1 to another position, then let go.
Check: it rests in the new position; holding it still, or clicking once in place, does not count.
practiceGoal_add-second:
Do: click a pattern in the rail on the left again to add a second shape.
Check: shape 1 is still there and the canvas holds two shapes.
practiceGoal_select-one:
Do: click the shape marked 1 once, to select only it.
Check: only that shape is selected; shape 2, or both shapes, does not count.
practiceGoal_select-many:
Do: click one shape, click Add to selection in the action bar at the bottom of the canvas, then click the other shape; a box select or Shift-click works too.
Check: shapes 1 and 2 are both selected.
practiceGoal_deselect:
Do: click empty canvas to clear the selection; if Add to selection in that action bar is on, click Finish selecting first.
Check: neither shape is selected any more.
practiceGoal_insert:
Do: click Add to answer at the far right of the bottom bar.
Check: a simulated insert appears; nothing is uploaded, attached, typed, or sent.
practiceGoal_complete: Practice finished: the steps in this chapter were practised, with nothing attached and nothing sent. That is not the same as knowing the maths, and the other chapters are still open.
tutorialDone: Tour finished. For the other operations, choose View tutorial below.
tutorialInsertPractice: Practice ends here: for real work, click Add to answer at the far right of the bottom bar, check it, then send it yourself.
tutorialInsertLater: Finish this tutorial step first; Add to answer works once the tour ends.
tutorialQAddBody: Click a pattern in the rail on the left to place it on the canvas.
tutorialQColorBody: Click a level colour on the left of the bottom bar; new shapes use that level.
tutorialQAddMoreBody: Click a pattern in the rail on the left again, so you have more to talk about.
tutorialQNoteBody: First select the shapes you want to explain (with nothing selected the note is for the whole board), then click the speech-bubble button on the right of the bottom bar.
tutorialQNoteSaveBody: When you are done, click Save at the bottom of the window.
tutorialQInsertBody: Click Add to answer at the far right of the bottom bar to attach the board to the conversation. In the tour one click is enough and nothing is really attached. To learn more: More actions → View tutorial.
tutorialGPointToolBody: First click the Point tool in the tool rail on the left, then place a point on the canvas.
tutorialGPlacePointBody: Click empty canvas to drop a labelled point.
tutorialGSegmentToolBody: Click the Segment tool in the tool rail on the left and join two points into a segment.
tutorialGDrawSegmentBody: Click two places (or existing points) on the canvas to draw a segment.
tutorialGNoteBody: First select the object you want to explain, then click the speech-bubble button on the right of the bottom bar.
tutorialGNoteSaveBody: When you are done, click Save at the bottom of the window.
tutorialGInsertBody: Click Add to answer at the far right of the bottom bar to attach the geometry board. In the tour one click is enough and nothing is really attached. To learn more: More actions → View tutorial.
practiceGoal_adjust-color:
Do: in the creation colours on the left of the bottom bar, click a level that differs from the current one.
Check: the creation colour moves to a new level; clicking the same level again does not count, and existing shapes stay as they are.
practiceGoal_adjust-color-add:
Do: click a pattern in the rail on the left to add one shape at the level you picked.
Check: the new shape matches that level's value and colour and older shapes keep theirs; if not, reset the step.
practiceGoal_adjust-pattern-add:
Do: click More patterns at the bottom of the rail on the left and add a pattern the rail does not have yet.
Check: that pattern appears in the rail on the left; opening the panel alone does not count.
practiceGoal_adjust-pattern-use:
Do: click Done at the bottom of the pattern library to close it, then click the new pattern in the rail and add a shape.
Check: the new shape uses that pattern; a different pattern does not count.
practiceGoal_adjust-pattern-hide:
Do: click More patterns again, tuck the same pattern away, then click Done at the bottom of the panel.
Check: the pattern leaves the rail, its shapes stay, and at least one pattern remains.
practiceGoal_adjust-change:
Do: click a pattern in the rail on the left to add one more shape, which the next step undoes and redoes.
Check: that new shape is on the canvas; earlier additions do not count for this step.
practiceGoal_adjust-undo:
Do: click Undo at the left end of the bottom bar.
Check: exactly that last addition disappears; if you changed something else, click Reset step in the step rail on the right.
practiceGoal_adjust-redo:
Do: click Redo at the left end of the bottom bar.
Check: that last addition is back; a button that cannot be clicked, or a different result, does not count.
practiceGoal_adjust-zoom:
Do: click Zoom in or Zoom out in the middle of the bottom bar.
Check: the zoom really changes; clicking the direction that has already reached its limit does not count.
practiceGoal_adjust-fit:
Do: click Fit width in the middle of the bottom bar.
Check: the view returns from the changed zoom to the whole practice board; clicking while it already fits does not count.
practiceGoal_adjust-clear:
Do: with content on the practice board, click Clear canvas on the right of the bottom bar, then click Confirm clear at the bottom of the window.
Check: shapes, notes, the modification record and the undo history are all cleared; your real draft and anything already attached stay as they are.
practiceGoal_adjust-fresh:
Do: click a pattern in the rail on the left to add one shape.
Check: the cleared content and history stay empty, and this new shape is the only one on the canvas.
practiceGoal_adjust-trace-option:
Do: click More actions on the right of the bottom bar and switch Attach modification record in the menu it opens.
Check: that option really changed; the snapshot and the record are two separate attachments, and turning the record off clears neither.
practiceGoal_organize-name:
Do: first select the shape marked 1, then click Name in the action bar at the bottom of the canvas, write a new name, and click Apply at the bottom of the window.
Check: a new, non-empty name is saved; an empty name, the old name, or naming another shape does not count.
practiceGoal_organize-reselect:
Do: first click empty canvas to clear the selection, then select only the shape marked 1.
Check: that shape is selected and the new name is still there; selecting another shape does not count.
practiceGoal_organize-peer:
Do: first select the shape marked 2, then give it the same name in the same way.
Check: both shapes share that name; a different name does not count, and this step cannot stand in for naming shape 1.
practiceGoal_organize-group:
Do: first select shapes 1 and 2 with Add to selection or a box select, then click Group in that action bar.
Check: the new group holds exactly those two members; a group with one member does not count. Grouping is not merging.
practiceGoal_organize-group-name:
Do: first select the whole group, then click Name in that action bar and change the group name to a new, non-empty name.
Check: the group shows the new name; keeping the current one does not count.
practiceGoal_organize-ungroup:
Do: first select that group, then click Ungroup in that action bar.
Check: both members are independent again; a click that leaves the group as it was does not count.
practiceGoal_organize-merge:
Do: first select the pair (same shape, value and name, and either in one group or both ungrouped), then click Merge in that action bar.
Check: one merged shape appears; a button that cannot be clicked, or a merge that fails, does not count. A gray result is not a mistake: it only means the total is not one of the level colours.
practiceGoal_organize-split:
Do: first select that merged shape, then click Split in that action bar.
Check: the recorded sources come back with their shape, value, colour, name and note; splitting another shape does not count.
practiceGoal_organize-copy:
Do: first select the shape marked 1, then click Copy in that action bar.
Check: a copy appears and the original stays; copying another shape does not count.
practiceGoal_organize-crossout:
Do: first select the shape marked 1, then click Cross out in that action bar.
Check: it stays on the board marked as crossed out; this is not deleting, and Undo brings it back.
practiceGoal_organize-delete:
Do: first select the shape marked 1, then click Delete selected at the right end of that action bar.
Check: only that shape disappears and the others stay; deleting another shape, or clearing the whole board, does not count.
practiceNotesHint: A note is your own words, not a checked math conclusion; where it lands depends on the current selection.
practiceGoal_notes-deselect:
Do: click empty canvas to clear the selection.
Check: nothing is selected, so the next note lands on the whole board; picking another shape does not count.
practiceGoal_notes-board:
Do: with nothing selected, click My explanation on the right of the bottom bar, write a note, then click Save at the bottom of the window.
Check: the note belongs to the whole board; empty text, cancel, or saving while something is selected does not count.
practiceGoal_notes-board-read:
Do: with nothing still selected, click My explanation again to open the note card.
Check: the card shows the board note you saved; a shape or group note does not count.
practiceGoal_notes-object:
Do: first select only the shape marked 1 (when it is in a group, click Add to selection and then click it), then click My explanation, write a note and save it.
Check: the note sits on that shape; a note on another shape, the group, or the board does not count.
practiceGoal_notes-object-check:
Do: first select only the shape marked 2, then click My explanation to open its note card.
Check: the card is not shape 1's note, and shape 1 still keeps its own.
practiceGoal_notes-group:
Do: first select the whole group (clicking one member selects the group), then click My explanation, write a note and save it.
Check: the note sits on the group; a note on a member, or on the board, does not count.
practiceGoal_notes-group-read:
Do: first select the whole group again, then click My explanation to open the note card.
Check: the card shows the group note; opening a member's own note does not count.
practiceGoal_notes-selection:
Do: first select that group, click Ungroup in the action bar, then use Add to selection for shapes 1 and 2 together, then click My explanation, write a note and save it.
Check: the note belongs to that pair; another pair, a single shape, or the board does not count.
practiceGoal_notes-selection-check:
Do: first select another pair and click My explanation to open their note; you can also clear the selection and open the board note.
Check: that card is not the pair note, and the marked pair still keeps it.
organizeNameExplain: Save a new non-empty name on the marked object.
organizeSelectExplain: Select only the marked object to read its saved name.
organizePeerExplain: Give the second marked object the same saved name.
organizeRenameGroupHint: This step needs its own action, not another rename.
organizeGroupExplain: Make one new group that contains both marked objects.
organizeGroupNameExplain: Change the group to a new non-empty name.
organizeUngroupExplain: Dissolve the marked group so both members are independent.
organizeMergeExplain: Merge the marked pair. A disabled or failed merge does not count, and a gray result is not a mistake.
organizeMergeNoteExplain: A note on these objects has to travel with the merge.
organizeSplitExplain: Split the merged object so its recorded sources return.
organizeCopyExplain: Copy the marked object once and leave the original in place.
organizeCrossoutExplain: Cross out the marked object and leave it on the board. Delete is a different step.
organizeDeleteExplain: Delete only the marked object. Other objects stay; clearing the board does not count.
organizeDeleteSelect: Select the marked object before deleting it.
organizeAddExplain: Adding a shape does not finish this step.
organizeMoveExplain: Moving a shape does not finish this step.
organizeNoteTarget: Notes are practiced in a later chapter.
notesDeselectExplain: Tap empty canvas and clear the current selection. Selecting a different object does not count.
notesEmptyExplain: Save a non-empty note. Empty text does not count.
notesBoardTarget: This step accepts only a whole-board note. Clear the selection, then save; an object, group, or multiple selection does not count.
notesBoardRead: With nothing selected, open the note again and read the board note you just saved. An object or group card does not count.
notesObjectTarget: Save a non-empty note on the marked object. Another object, the board, or a group does not count.
notesObjectCheck: Select only the other practice object. Its note is not the marked object's text, and the marked object still has its own note.
notesGroupTarget: Save a non-empty note on the target group. A member's note or the board note does not count.
notesGroupRead: Select the whole group again and open its note. A member's own note is not the group note.
notesSelectionTarget: Save a non-empty note on this marked set of objects. A different set, a single object, or the board does not count.
notesSelectionCheck: Open another pair, or the board note with nothing selected. That card must not show this selection note, and the marked set still has it.
notesCancelExplain: Cancel does not save the note or advance this step.
notesMiss: This step is not done yet. A note belongs to whatever the current selection names.
textHint: e.g. area = length × width. Save to write it; Esc cancels.
geometryPracticeBasics: Geometry safe basics — separate from your answer
geometryPracticeInsert: Simulation only: a real geometry insert contains one geometry snapshot and your whole-board note, with no geometry modification record. Nothing uploaded, attached, inserted or sent.
geometryPracticeGoal_point:
Do: click the Point tool in the tool rail on the left, then click empty canvas once.
Check: a free point appears on the canvas; selecting the tool alone does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_segment:
Do: click the Segment tool in the tool rail on the left, click that point, then click another position.
Check: a complete segment appears; one endpoint only, or a drawing that stops halfway, does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_triangle:
Do: click the Triangle tool in the tool rail on the left, reuse the segment's two endpoints, then click a third position.
Check: a closed triangle appears; side lengths and angles are not judged here.
geometryPracticeGoal_polygon:
Do: click the Polygon tool in the tool rail on the left, click at least three vertices in empty space, then click back on the first one.
Check: the outline closes; an outline that never closes does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_circle:
Do: click the Circle tool in the tool rail on the left, click the centre, then click a point on the circle.
Check: a circle appears; a centre alone does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_select-one:
Do: click the Select tool in the tool rail on the left, then click point A only.
Check: only A is selected; a wrong target does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_deselect:
Do: click empty canvas, then let go.
Check: nothing is selected; resting the pointer on the canvas does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_insert:
Do: click Add to answer at the far right of the bottom bar.
Check: a simulated insert appears; a real insert carries only the geometry snapshot and the board note, and nothing is uploaded or sent here.
geometryPracticeGoal_complete: Basic practice finished: nothing was attached and nothing was sent. This only means the steps were practised, not that the maths is mastered.
geometryPracticeConstruct: Geometry construct practice — separate from your answer
geometryPracticeGoal_construct-parallelo:
Do: click the Parallelogram tool in the tool rail on the left and finish one with three clicks.
Check: a new parallelogram appears; selecting the tool alone, an unfinished preview, or a plain polygon does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_construct-rectangle:
Do: click the Rectangle tool in the tool rail on the left and finish one with three clicks.
Check: a new rectangle appears; a parallelogram or an unfinished preview does not stand in.
geometryPracticeGoal_construct-select-si:
Do: click the Select tool in the tool rail on the left, then click one segment, or one side of a polygon, rectangle or parallelogram.
Check: that side is selected, both ends are free points and no midpoint exists yet; clicking just a point or a circle does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_construct-midpoint:
Do: first select that side, then click Midpoint in the tool rail on the left.
Check: a new midpoint appears on that side; dropping a free point somewhere else does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_construct-drag:
Do: drag the marked free point and let go after moving it.
Check: the point rests in a new position; holding it without moving does not count, and a derived point cannot be dragged directly.
geometryPracticeGoal_construct-auxiliary:
Do: turn the Auxiliary switch on in the tool rail on the left, then draw one auxiliary figure yourself.
Check: a new auxiliary figure appears; flicking the switch does not count.

Do: after that figure is drawn, turn the Auxiliary switch off in the tool rail on the left.
Check: the switch is off and the figure stays; turning it off before any auxiliary figure exists does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_construct-complete: Construction practice finished: nothing was attached and nothing was sent. This only means these steps were done, not that any side or angle relation holds, and not that a conclusion is right.
geometryPracticeEdit: Geometry edit and notes practice — separate from your answer
geometryPracticeEditHint: Text and notes are your own words, not a checked geometry conclusion; where a note lands depends on the current selection.
geometryPracticeGoal_edit-rename:
Do: first select the marked point, then click Rename point in the action bar at the bottom of the canvas and save a new, non-empty name.
Check: the point carries the new name; an empty name, cancel, an unchanged name, or a duplicate does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_edit-text-add:
Do: click the Text tool in the tool rail on the left, click empty canvas, and save some non-empty writing.
Check: the text appears on the canvas; cancel, or saving empty text, does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_edit-text-change:
Do: first select that text, then click Edit text in that action bar, change it and save.
Check: the same text now reads differently; writing a second text does not stand in for it.
geometryPracticeGoal_edit-delete:
Do: first select the marked object, then click Delete selected in that action bar.
Check: that object is gone and other objects stay; deleting another object, or clearing the whole board, does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_edit-point-note:
Do: first select the marked point, then click My explanation on the right of the bottom bar, write a note and save it.
Check: the note sits on that point; a note on a text, or on a shape, does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_edit-element-note:
Do: first select the marked shape, then click My explanation on the right of the bottom bar and save a note of 1 to 20 characters.
Check: the note is saved and its short label appears on the canvas; a longer note, a point note, or an empty note does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_edit-caption:
Do: click the short label on the canvas directly, change that note to something else and save it.
Check: the short label shows the new content; opening the card only, or editing another shape, does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_edit-deselect:
Do: click empty canvas, then let go.
Check: nothing is selected.
geometryPracticeGoal_edit-board-note:
Do: with nothing selected, click My explanation on the right of the bottom bar, write a board note and save it.
Check: the note belongs to the whole board; saving empty text, or writing it on a point or shape, does not count (a newly added object is selected automatically).
geometryPracticeGoal_edit-complete: Editing practice finished: nothing was attached and nothing was sent. Text and notes are your own words; they are not a geometry conclusion and not a verdict on your answer.
geometryPracticeAdjust: Geometry adjust and recover practice — separate from your answer
geometryPracticeGoal_adjust-grid:
Do: click Grid: off on the left of the bottom bar to turn the grid on, then place a new point while it is on.
Check: the grid is on and the new point is there; turning the grid on alone does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_adjust-snap:
Do: click Snap: on on the left of the bottom bar to turn snap off, then place a new point.
Check: snap is off and the new point is there; turning snap off alone does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_adjust-undo:
Do: click Undo at the left end of the bottom bar.
Check: the new point is gone, the board is back to how it was before it, and Redo is available; a click while Undo cannot be used does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_adjust-redo:
Do: click Redo at the left end of the bottom bar.
Check: the same point is back; a click while Redo cannot be used does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_adjust-zoom:
Do: click Zoom in in the middle of the bottom bar.
Check: the zoom number changes; clicking the level it is already at, or a click that leaves the number unchanged, does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_adjust-scroll:
Do: scroll the canvas while it is zoomed in, or while the view does not fit.
Check: the position of the view changes; scrolling that leaves it unchanged does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_adjust-fit:
Do: click Fit width in the middle of the bottom bar.
Check: the view fits again; clicking while it already fits does not count.
geometryPracticeGoal_adjust-clear:
Do: with content on the board, click Clear geometry canvas on the right of the bottom bar, then click Confirm clear at the bottom of the window.
Check: the practice board and its undo history are empty; opening the confirm alone does not count, and Undo cannot go back past the clear. The quantity board is untouched.
geometryPracticeGoal_adjust-complete: Adjustment practice finished: nothing was attached and nothing was sent. The grid and snap are not evidence about geometry, and the undo history cleared earlier does not come back.
practiceGoal_files-save:
Do: click More actions on the right of the bottom bar and save this practice board from the menu.
Check: the practice file is really saved, or a download has started; clicking Save JSON alone does not count, and a started download does not mean the disk write was verified.
practiceGoal_files-open:
Do: click Open JSON in the More actions menu and open a quantity practice file.
Check: the practice board becomes that file; cancel, a file this board cannot read, or a geometry file does not count. The real draft is not loaded, and opening a file does not bring back the modification record.
practiceGoal_files-complete: File practice finished: nothing was attached and nothing was sent. Your real answer and its file stay unchanged; skipping this chapter does not block quantity basics.
geometryPracticeFiles: Geometry file practice — separate from your answer
geometryPracticeGoal_files-save:
Do: click More actions on the right of the bottom bar and save this practice geometry board from the menu.
Check: the practice file is really saved, or a download has started; clicking Save JSON alone does not count, and a started download is not verified as a disk write.
geometryPracticeGoal_files-open:
Do: click Open JSON in the More actions menu and open a geometry practice file.
Check: the practice board becomes that file; cancel, a file this board cannot read, or a quantity file does not count. The real draft is not loaded, and geometry gains no modification record.
geometryPracticeGoal_files-complete: Geometry file practice finished: nothing was attached and nothing was sent. Your real geometry answer and its file stay unchanged; skipping this chapter does not block geometry basics.
teacherDemoPractice: Teacher demo guide — separate from your answer
teacherDemoFigureUnavailable: The teacher figure is unavailable. You can exit, or continue later. This does not mark the copy complete.
teacherDemoTutorialNoFigure: The teacher has not placed a figure on the demo page yet, so there is nothing to practise. Press View tutorial again once a figure appears.
teacherDemoPracticeGoal_demo-read:
Do: read this page (read-only, the teacher's work cannot be changed), then click Continue in the step rail on the right.
Check: the guide moves on; the page does not judge your explanation, and does not put the figure on your geometry board.
teacherDemoPracticeGoal_demo-view:
Do: click Zoom in below the figure title, then scroll the canvas to see the rest.
Check: the zoom number changes and the view has scrolled; clicking the current level does not count.
teacherDemoPracticeGoal_demo-copy:
Do: click Put on my geometry board below the figure title.
Check: the figure is appended to this guide's practice board; the teacher's figure and your real draft stay unchanged, and no file is attached.
teacherDemoPracticeGoal_demo-return:
Do: click the Geometry tab at the top, then click View the editable copy in the step rail on the right.
Check: the practice copy is there and you can edit it; this copy is never uploaded and never counted as real help.
teacherDemoPracticeGoal_demo-complete: Teacher demo guide finished: the practice copy stays in this guide, not in your answer; exit to return to your real geometry draft.
practiceSealed: Practice is separate from your answer; exiting returns to it unchanged.
tutorialNoteOpen: Save this note first: the next tour step is inside this window.
